candidate.derivedAnswer: A. A hyperbola whose foci lie on the x-axis
candidate.answerReason: The equation has the form x²/a²−y²/b²=1 with positive denominators. Its positive x² term places its focal axis on the x-axis.

methods.label: Recognize the curve and focal axis
methods.explanation: The difference of the two terms equals \(1\), and the \(x^2\) term comes first, so the foci lie on the x-axis.
methods.levelReason: Identifying the curve and focal axis from its standard equation is a direct high-school conic task.
